name: Confidence
description: Improves mental abilities based on emotional state
info:
- CONFIDENCE -

This trait enhances your mental abilities based on your emotional state. Positive emotions improve your focus, while negative emotions boost your sharpness.

''Confidence is not about always feeling good, it's about doing your best despite how you feel.''

name: Morale
description: Improves physical and mental abilities based on emotional state
info:
- MORALE -

This trait boosts both physical and mental abilities based on your emotional state. Positive emotions provide a balanced boost to both attributes, while negative emotions increase the bonus at the cost of emotional strain.

''Morale is the spark that ignites strength, whether it's through optimism or adversity.''

name: Temperament
description: Improves physical ability, mental ability or Health based on emotional state
info:
- TEMPERAMENT -

This trait enhances physical abilities, mental sharpness, or health based on emotional state. Positive emotions boost physical strength, while negative emotions improve health at the cost of mental clarity.

''Temperament shapes how we respond to the world.''

name: Interest
description: Improves mental abilities based on addiction state
info:
- INTEREST -

This trait boosts mental abilities depending on your addiction state. Positive addiction enhances focus, while negative addiction sharpens the mind further but increases emotional strain. When neutral, it provides a steady mental boost.

''Interest fuels the mind, for better or worse.''

name: Bravery
description: Improves mainly physical and mental abilities based on addiction state
info:
- BRAVERY -

This trait enhances physical and mental abilities based on addiction state. Positive addiction boosts strength and focus, while negative addiction further increases abilities but raises addiction. Neutral state offers a balanced increase.

''Bravery is not the absence of fear, but the strength to move forward despite it.''

name: Resilience
description: Improves mainly health based on emotional state
info:
- RESILIENCE -

This trait enhances health based on emotional state. Positive emotions improve health but lower emotional balance, while negative emotions offer a smaller boost with more strain. Neutral emotions provide a balanced increase in health and strength.

''Resilience is the ability to recover, no matter what life throws at you.''

name: Mental Clarity
description: Improves mainly mental abilities based on emotional and addiction state
info:
- MENTAL CLARITY -

This trait enhances mental abilities based on emotional and addiction states. A neutral emotional and addiction state boosts mental clarity the most. Positive or negative emotional and addiction states provide balanced improvements with varying effects.

''Clarity of mind is the foundation of wise decisions, no matter the circumstances.''

name: Inner Balance
description: Improves mainly emotional or addiction state
info:
- INNER BALANCE -

This trait helps maintain emotional and addiction equilibrium. A neutral state balances health, while positive or negative emotions or addiction levels prompt adjustments toward stability.

''True balance comes when emotions and addictions are kept in harmony, allowing for a clearer path forward.''
